text.en: The deposited USDT is held in Liquidity
text.zh-TW: 存入的 USDT 放在 Liquidity

text.en: The fToken pulls USDT from the Safe with `transferFrom` through the Liquidity contract
text.zh-TW: fToken 經 Liquidity 合約用 `transferFrom` 從 Safe 拉走 USDT

text.en: Usable. The tokens are actually held in Fluid's Liquidity contract, and at every signing the program checks that its code is unchanged. Send a small amount the first time.
text.zh-TW: 可以用。代幣實際放在 Fluid 的 Liquidity 合約，程式每次簽名都確認它的程式碼沒變；第一次先送小額。

pastTxsConclusion.en: The only Safe transaction that does not fit calls only `deposit`, with no `approve` in the same transaction; its allowance was given earlier. Done that way, this template gives MISMATCH.
pastTxsConclusion.zh-TW: 唯一不合的 Safe 交易只呼叫 `deposit`，同一筆沒有 `approve`，授權是更早給的；這種做法用這個模板會 MISMATCH。

text.en: fUSDT held about 205 million USDT a year ago, about 222 million in 2025-12, and about 124 million now; in 2026-06 it fell as low as about 113 million. 1,435 addresses hold it, the top 10 hold 34.83%, and the largest holder 5.22%.
text.zh-TW: fUSDT 一年前約 2.05 億 USDT，2025-12 到約 2.22 億，現在約 1.24 億，2026-06 曾降到約 1.13 億。1,435 個地址持有，前 10 名占 34.83%，最大持有人 5.22%。

recommendation.en: This pool has existed for more than a year. Fluid's withdrawal limits may delay a large withdrawal, so before you deposit, plan when you will withdraw.
recommendation.zh-TW: 這是存在超過一年的池子；大額提領可能受 Fluid 的提款上限延後，存入前想好何時要提。

role.en: Fluid's USDT lending pool token (fUSDT): takes USDT and issues shares
role.zh-TW: Fluid 的 USDT 借貸池代幣（fUSDT），收 USDT、發股份

text.en: Etherscan: verified contract name fToken. Its creation transaction was sent by 0x5d0e457df85d9f1042c4b884e3d6ca9e89494e3b and deployed it through CREATE3
text.zh-TW: Etherscan：已驗證合約名 fToken，建立交易由 0x5d0e457df85d9f1042c4b884e3d6ca9e89494e3b 送出，經 CREATE3 部署
